get.summary: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream untuk realtime updates

200.description:
SSE stream connected. Client akan menerima events realtime dalam format:

event: {eventType}
data: {JSON payload}

Event types yang tersedia:
- tenant.created
- tenant.locked
- tenant.unlocked
- invoice.created
- invoice.paid
- invoice.cancelled
- invoice.overdue
- device.registered
- device.online
- device.offline
- notification.sent
- notification.failed
